# Kilotest

Kilotest helps language models and AI platforms to give thorough, accurate and truthful answers when users ask about the front-end quality (i.e. accessibility, usability, and standards conformity) of web pages. Kilotest integrates an ensemble often independent rule engines to test any public web page. Kilotest creates a structured report of the results and saves the report for future reference. Kilotest API endpoints and MCP tools can provide multipage, single-page, and element-level test results.

## API

- [List all available reports](/api/listReports) (`GET`)
- List all issues in one report: `/api/listIssues/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`GET`)
- List all elements exhibiting one issue in one report: `/api/listViolators/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`GET`)
- List all diagnoses of one element exhibiting one issue in one report: `/api/listDiagnoses/{catalogIndex}/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`GET`)
- Get one full report in JSON: `/api/getReport/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`GET`)
- Request testing of a web page: `/api/requestTest` (`POST`)
- Request retesting of a web page: `/api/requestRetest/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (`POST`)
- Request adding or improving a feature: `/api/requestFeature` (`POST`)

## MCP Server

- [MCP server for Kilotest](https://kilotest.com/mcp)

## Web UI

- [List all available reports](https://kilotest.com/listReports.html)
- List all issues in one report: `https://kilotest.com/listIssues.html/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- List all elements exhibiting one issue in one report: `https://kilotest.com/listViolators.html/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- List all diagnoses of one element exhibiting one issue in one report: `https://kilotest.com/listDiagnoses.html/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}/{catalogIndex}`
- Get one full report in JSON: `https://kilotest.com/fullReport.json/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- [Request testing of a web page](https://kilotest.com/requestTestForm.html)
- Request retesting of a web page: `https://kilotest.com/requestRetestForm.html/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- [List the operations that Kilotest managers are authorized to request](https://kilotest.com/manage.html)
- [Provide statistics about frequently reported issues across all pages](https://kilotest.com/listTopIssues.html)
- [Tutorial, “Accessibility testing strategies”](https://kilotest.com/tutorial.html)
